skill.name: push-to-linkedcamp
skill.description: Builds or takes a prospect list, confirms each person's current role and verified work email with Leadsets search_people and enrich_person, and loads the send-ready leads into a LinkedCamp campaign with catch-alls held apart. Use when someone asks to push leads to LinkedCamp, load a list into a LinkedCamp campaign, or send prospects to LinkedCamp.
skill.summary: Checks prospect roles and work emails with Leadsets, then adds verified contacts to a LinkedCamp campaign without starting it.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The shell execution and system reconnaissance alerts match documentation, not executable code or host inspection. The documented workflow uses Leadsets and transfers verified contact data to LinkedCamp, but lacks campaign-state checks and privacy safeguards for CSV exports. No evidence of prompt injection or an unrelated data destination was found.

remediation.issue: Campaign writes do not require a destination or sending-state check
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the workspace, campaign ID, and lead count before writing. Check suppression lists and stop if adding leads could trigger an active sequence.

remediation.issue: CSV exports include contact data by default
remediation.suggestion: Ask before exporting contact details and confirm the storage destination. Limit columns, restrict access, and set a retention period.

content.value_statement: Outdated roles, uncertain email addresses, and duplicates make prospect lists hard to use. This skill checks contact details with Leadsets and adds verified leads to LinkedCamp without starting the campaign.
actual_capabilities: Checks Leadsets usage limits and tests search criteria with a single result before a larger search.
Finds prospects from role and company criteria or enriches contacts from an existing list.
Checks current roles and company details, then separates verified addresses from catch-all and unknown addresses.
Removes duplicate contacts and skips people already in the target campaign.
Adds verified contacts to the named LinkedCamp campaign and checks the lead count after import.
Reports usage and import counts, with CSV reports for skipped contacts and catch-all addresses.
limitations: Requires a Leadsets MCP connection or REST API key and a separate LinkedCamp connection with campaign access.
Search and enrichment quotas can stop a run before it reaches the requested lead count.
Does not write messages, start campaigns, or schedule sending.
Does not supply phone numbers or add unverified addresses to the main campaign.

use_cases.title: Check an existing prospect list
use_cases.description: Refresh roles and verify work emails before adding contacts from a supplied list to a paused campaign.

use_cases.title: Build a first campaign list
use_cases.description: Find people who match a target role, industry, and region, then import only verified contacts.

use_cases.title: Replenish a campaign without duplicates
use_cases.description: Add verified contacts who are not already in the campaign and review counts for contacts that were skipped.

prompt_templates.title: Import a supplied list
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: You already have a prospect list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the roles and work emails in [prospect list]. After I confirm the paused campaign [campaign name], add only verified contacts. Do not start sending.

prompt_templates.title: Search from target criteria
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: You need new prospects for a specific audience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to [count] verified [job titles] at [company type] in [region]. Test the filters with one result first. Confirm the paused campaign [campaign name] with me before importing.

prompt_templates.title: Refill an existing campaign
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: You need new leads without adding existing contacts again.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [count] new contacts who match [criteria]. Exclude people already in [campaign name] and hold back catch-all addresses. After I approve the import, check the lead count and summarize duplicates.

prompt_templates.title: Review a quota-limited import
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: You need to control usage and approve the destination and exports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Leadsets quota before processing [list or criteria]. Report the planned batch size and verify that adding leads to [campaign name] will not trigger sending. Wait for approval before importing or exporting contact details.

output_examples.input: Check 25 supplied contacts and add verified leads to the approved, paused Partner Outreach campaign.
output: Three verified contacts were already in the campaign, so 15 were added.
Seven contacts were held back because their roles changed or their email addresses were not verified.
No messages were started or scheduled by this run.

output_examples.input: Find 20 verified leads for the approved, paused Regional Sales campaign and keep catch-all addresses separate.
output: The search found 26 prospects matching the criteria.
The campaign received 17 verified leads. Four catch-all addresses were held in a separate CSV.
Five prospects were skipped because their roles changed or they had no verified address.

best_practices: Confirm the LinkedCamp workspace, campaign, and sending state before authorizing an import.
Test your search filters with one result and check the remaining Leadsets quota before scaling up.
Review skipped-contact counts first and approve a restricted destination before exporting contact details.
anti_patterns: Importing catch-all addresses into the main verified campaign.
Treating an old CRM email or a search result as current verification.
Assuming a named campaign is paused or that adding leads cannot trigger an active sequence.

faq.question: What information can I start with?
faq.answer: Provide target roles and company criteria, or provide a list with names and company domains or LinkedIn profile URLs.

faq.question: What connections does the skill need?
faq.answer: It needs Leadsets access through MCP or a REST API key. It also needs a separate LinkedCamp connection with campaign access.

faq.question: Will it send outreach messages?
faq.answer: The skill does not start or schedule sending. Check that your campaign will not act on newly added leads before importing.

faq.question: What happens to catch-all addresses?
faq.answer: By default, the skill excludes them from the main campaign and lists them in a separate CSV. You can request a separate campaign instead.

faq.question: Does it skip contacts already in LinkedCamp?
faq.answer: It checks for duplicates by person and email, then skips contacts already in the target campaign.

faq.question: What happens if I run out of Leadsets quota?
faq.answer: The skill checks usage before processing. If a limit stops the run, it reports what remains and when the quota resets, if known.
